Format

Individual Mexicano

Partner rotate by standings. Individual points.

Individual Americano

Partner rotate round-robin. Individual points. Fair sit-out.

Mix-Mexicano

Mixed pairs, Mexicano-style. Partner rotate by standings. 1 per kubu per team (gender / posisi / custom). Individual points.

Mix-Americano

Mixed pairs, Americano-style. Partner rotate round-robin. 1 per kubu per team (gender / posisi / custom). Individual points. Fair sit-out.

Team Mexicano

Fix pair. Pair rotate by standings. Pair points.

Team Americano

Fix pair. Pair rotate round-robin. Pair points.

Club Sparing

Fix pair, antar klub. Tiap match dipaksa lintas klub (Klub A vs Klub B). Skor + pemenang kategori dihitung terpisah dari klasemen pair.

Tournament

Fix pair. Grup round-robin → knockout bracket. Drawing/kocok grup.
